executive_summary: Market regime assessed as bullish (graph score 1.0, confidence 0.75) but with critical data gaps in primary Iranian exchange feeds.

فملی (FMLI) remains the flagship thesis: operating leverage + copper sensitivity + volume-led growth + market leadership. Current price 27,690 (11 Aban 1405) well above thesis price map targets (20,500/21,500/23,000), suggesting extended move.
Sector rotation favors Basic Metals (+1.66%), Auto (+1.87%), Rubber (+2.56%); Oil Products (-2.72%) and Wood (-2.89%) lagging.
Market breadth positive: 401 advancing vs 206 declining (Kamandar 11 Aban). Equal-weight index (+0.45%) outperforming cap-weighted TEDPIX (-0.07%).
Options liquidity concentrated in شستا (Shesta), خودرو (Khodro), وبملت (Webmelt), فملی (FMLI). فملی OI highest at 28,000/30,000 call strikes.
Macro backdrop: Brent >$100 on US-Iran tensions, Hormuz risk, Iran gasoline price hike → inflation → rate hike risk. Rial weakness benefits exporters.
Pezeshkian admits sanctions hurting economy, trade down 25-35%, but seeks diplomatic de-escalation.
Critical data gaps: TSE/TSETMC/Codal all timeout; no real-time Client Type flow, no option Greeks/IV, stale MarketWatch Plus (1405-06-07).
فملی thesis validation: sales growth 183% YoY, profit growth 262% YoY (Q1 1405), copper price supportive, but price 27,690 >> thesis confirmation 20,000.
Decision: WAIT for pullback to accumulation zone (19,400-19,800) or confirmed support with volume. Do not chase extended move.
